title: Anthropic Shipped Its Best Model Twice. You Get One
description:
Claude Fable 5.1 and Claude Mythos 5.1 are the same model with different safeguards, and only Fable is public. Anthropic's own benchmark table has Mythos at 60.9% on Terminal-Bench 4.0 against Fable's 55.8%, and the footnote says that gap is the tasks where the cyber safeguards stepped in. Penetration testing, exploit generation and binary scanning get handed to Opus instead. Fable keeps the $10 in, $50 out pricing, cache reads dropped 75%, and typical work runs about 25% cheaper.

Source: https://www.anthropic.com/claude-fable-and-mythos-5-1
